content: I found GradedMonoid restrict the multiplication to A i => A j => A (i + j). However, for generating graded ring instance on direct sum, this inolves lots of Heq problems. How about refactor it as A i => A j => A k for i + j = k? This moves especially associtivity problem to the index set, which is direct lemmas.

However, for generating graded ring instance on direct sum, this inolves lots of Heq problems

Could you elaborate on this? Are you using docs#DirectSum.GRing ?
The pattern that we seem to be using elsewhere is docs#TensorPower.gradedMonoid_eq_of_cast, which replaces the HEq with some well-behaved casting operator
Yes, I am indeed using DirectSum.G(Comm)Ring for associated graded ring. I once struggled with Heq for a while about this.

I am currently needing for I an ideal of R, ⨁ i, I^i / I • ⊤ have an R/I algebra structure, and an surjection R/I[x_1, x_2, ... x_n] when mapping x_1, x_2, ... x_n to generators of I. Do you have suggestions for this? Thanks
Could you make a #mwe with the troublesome proofs sorryd?
You can probably find trouble in #33218, however a mwe might take some time, sorry (I am leaving my computer for a while).

I encountered a similar problem in #36287 when preparing graded Lie algebras. I ended up including the condition i + j = k as you suggested (but my situation was slightly different, since I was assuming a bracket was given in the beginning).
I don't think the equality is serving any purpose in that case at all @Scott Carnahan; the argument for it only (maybe) applies when workign with types, not sets
@Nailin Guan, is #33217 enough to see the trouble, or do I need the downstream PR?
You need to go downstream one step to #33218, that PR is only taking the direct sum of pieces and wrapping basic APIs. I only put the Heq lemmas there but it is not the case.
@Nailin Guan: Did you see https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/33217#discussion_r3094253572? This might make the HEq discussion irrelevant.
Sorry, I am a little outdated on this, but it still needs to take GCommRing
